raw_segments.text: As far as person went, she answered point for point, both to my picture and Mrs. Fairfax's
The noble bust, the sloping shoulders, the graceful neck, the dark eyes and black ringlets
But her face—her face was like her mother's, a youthful unfurrowed likeness, the same low
brow, the same high features, the same pride.
It was not, however, so saturnine a pride.
Her laugh was satirical, and so was the habitual expression of her arched and haughty lip.
